content.subject: Fulfillment breadth often creates reconciliation work
content.draft_text:
Hi AJ,
When a fulfillment provider lists dozens of service options, such as core, 3PL, platform-specific, keeping the underlying order and inventory data aligned can turn into a manual reconciliation marathon. That friction is what we target.
We build a workflow that pulls each transaction into a single ledger, letting teams reconcile without manual spreadsheets.
Is manual reconciliation a bottleneck for your team?
